intro: Qatari culture mixes Bedouin and seafaring traditions with big investments in museums and art.

chapters.title: Traditions
text: Falconry, camel racing and the majlis are central. Souq Waqif in Doha is a traditional market.
The Museum of Islamic Art and the National Museum, shaped like a desert rose crystal, are landmarks.

chapters.title: Food
text: Machboos and harees are traditional dishes, and karak tea is everywhere.

keyTerms.meaning: A crystal formation found in the desert.

items.name: National Sport Day
items.text: Second Tuesday of February, a public holiday.
